_comment: Example: per-camera Ring motion poll. Copy this file to configs/routines/private/<your_camera>_motion_poll.json, set spec.camera_id to your Ring device id (find via /settings/integrations/ring), and flip enabled=true. Add a trigger.active_window if you only want it polling during certain hours (see configs/windows.json).
name: Example Ring camera motion poll
notes: Polls Ring's recent-events history for one camera. On any new motion/ding event since the watermark, captures a fresh snapshot via the Ring bridge → publishes ring_snapshot_captured → camera_dispatch routes to the analyzer + skill configured for this camera in configs/cameras.json.
